entries.resolution: src/creatures/monsters/monsters.cpp deserializeSpell sets COMBAT_PARAM_BLOCKARMOR and COMBAT_PARAM_BLOCKSHIELD on a monster melee, so its damage is reduced by the target armor and shield defense (mitigated_by). Melee chance normalized to 100: monsters.cpp deserializeSpell: melee is scheduled by interval; the declared chance is not applied.

monsters.cpp deserializeSpell speed: speedChange < -1000 clamps to -1000; >0 haste (non-aggressive), else paralyze; default duration 10000 ms; multiplier = 1 + speedChange/1000, formula vars (multiplier/2, 40, multiplier, 40).

Corpse and its decay chain are local capability projections from appearances.dat + items.xml; items.cpp: blockSolid=unpass, blockProjectile=unsight, blockPathFind=avoid, pickupable=take, movable=!unmove. Weight absent in items.xml is the engine default 0. Duration seconds -> ms.

src/utils/const.hpp MAX_LOOTCHANCE=100000, so percent = chance/1000. Item 10293 "striped fur" is a declared source-scoped reference, not an admitted canonical Item. Probability taken from the wiki estimate (source 2); Canary had 10.83% (Owner decision D15: where the reference-date (2026-09-27) wiki differs from Canary, the wiki value replaces it; applied to health, experience, armor, mitigation, element modifiers, flags, summon/convince mana cost, flee health, Bestiary difficulty/occurrence (and the Bestiary class when Canary names no valid race), loot items missing in Canary and loot probabilities; never to an uncertain (? or ~) or unparsed wiki value). Count 1-1 replaced by 1-3 (D32 loot amount: with an adopted wiki estimate (>= 10 drops) the Loot Statistics amount is the per-kill count observed when the item drops; a count outside the Canary range replaces the Canary min-max, and a Canary minimum of 0 becomes 1 because the estimate already counts kills without it).
